test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 2 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : DKR :: PCL: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and third letters → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• # = BNQ, % = NFM ⇒ BNQ : DKR :: PCL: NFM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6382a76f6b80f38fd752a94841f511d55391274b9cf98c8b0d8ac43417e22db.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = FHT, % = NFJ ⇒ FHT : DKR :: PCL: NFJ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b8ac1208c79091b873c3aa46412b224fcdf684f371d451a12fa84cc3aa53381.png] 

⇒Here, similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = COQ, % = OGH ⇒ COQ : DKR :: PCL: OGH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59c3f16cf92bb288115acfd78c5af9db203748d2909cd95d8d9b7f4a85cb187a.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = BNP, % = NFJ ⇒ BNP : DKR :: PCL: NFJ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/638dc0b88e53de8911f0bc9960094d62fa10f427eaded8531e7fd09ced783765.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (2)".
